Title: Bake Sale for Roof Repair
Time: Saturday, March 15, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM
Description: We need volunteers to bake and sell goods. All proceeds go to the church roof fund. Please note the new health rules: no unpasteurized items.

Title: Lease Renewal Discussion
Time: Thursday, April 3, 6:30 PM – 7:30 PM
Description: Hi Sarah, I'd like to go over the lease renewal terms before we sign. The landlord mentioned a few changes: the pet policy now includes a monthly fee, and the maintenance rules for the backyard have been updated. I also want to clarify the clause about early termination—if we need to delete that section, we should discuss alternatives. Let's meet at the kitchen table with the paperwork. Also, I used that AI lease-review chatbot to scan the document, and it flagged a couple of ambiguous phrases, so we can go over those too.

Title: Draft Review: 'Neural Networks for Climate Modeling'
Time: Wednesday, May 7, 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM
Description: Please review the latest draft before the deadline. We'll discuss the new sections and any prompt feedback from the reviewers.

Title: Charity 5K Run – Volunteer Orientation
Time: Friday, June 12, 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Description: Mandatory orientation for all race-day volunteers. We'll cover safety rules, check-in procedures, and course setup. Please bring a water bottle.

Title: Apartment Inspection Walkthrough
Time: Tuesday, July 8, 9:00 AM – 10:00 AM
Description: Annual inspection with the property manager. We'll check for maintenance issues and review the building's noise rules. Please ensure pets are secured.

Title: Research Paper Draft Meeting
Time: Monday, August 18, 10:00 AM – 11:30 AM
Description: Let's finalize the draft of our paper on automated content moderation. The new section on prompt engineering needs a careful review—we should clarify how we define 'prompt' in the context of our model. I also want to discuss the dataset cleaning; we may need to delete some entries that don't meet the inclusion criteria. Additionally, we should override the previous annotation rules where they conflict with the updated guidelines. Please bring your comments and the latest version. Also, I'll show you the AI writing assistant we used to generate the abstract, just to ensure it's not too generic.

Title: Charity Gala Planning Committee
Time: Thursday, September 4, 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM
Description: Discuss venue, catering, and entertainment. Review budget and sponsorship rules. All members must attend.

Title: Lease Signing Appointment
Time: Friday, October 10, 3:00 PM – 3:30 PM
Description: Final walkthrough and signing. Bring ID and proof of insurance. We'll delete the old addendum from the file.

Title: Paper Revision: Address Reviewer Comments
Time: Wednesday, November 5, 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM
Description: Go through the reviewer feedback and update the manuscript. We need to override the previous conclusion based on new data.

Title: Volunteer Appreciation Event
Time: Saturday, December 13, 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Description: Join us to celebrate our volunteers! We'll have food, games, and a short presentation. Please RSVP by December 10. Note: the venue has a strict noise policy, and we must follow their rules. We'll also demo the new AI chatbot that answers common volunteer questions—it's still in beta, so we'll collect feedback. If you can't attend, please delete your sign-up from the sheet.
